```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden took historic steps to help Americans rent, buy, and build.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American Rescue Plan kept 8 million families in their homes nationwide by preventing foreclosures and evictions during the pandemic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration eased rising rents by capping rent hikes in 2 million federally-funded apartments.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration led the biggest expansion of rental assistance for low-income families in 20 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is cracking down on slumlords who do not play by the rules.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration reduced mortgage-insurance premiums on federally-backed loans for 700,000 homeowners.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration waived the requirement for title insurance, saving families up to $1,500 to refinance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More people own homes today than did before the pandemic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There are fewer foreclosures today than at any time in decades.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The surest way to bring housing costs down long-term is to build to boost supply.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is cutting red tape to help more builders get federal financing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A record 1.7 million new housing units are under construction today nationwide.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
